verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API that mirrors dashboard functionality, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-out examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes at standard docs paths all returned 404. The CLI's raw API access is a separate tool and does not count as an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
